color.summary: Neutral greys with no tint, set as alpha on the surface (CDS variables). Light: pages and menus are #fff, the sidebar #fafafa, text is black at 90% (#191919), 60% (#666) and 47% (#888), edges black at 8% (#ebebeb) and 12% (#e0e0e0). Dark: the page is #191919, menus and dialogs #1f1f1f to #303030, text white at 93%, 57% and 40%. Primary buttons are filled in the ink color and invert in dark. Clay #c6613f is kept for the send button. Blue #1757ac (#6aabf1 in dark) colors accent text and badges, #257de0 focus rings and the checked checkbox; red #a42528 (#f17778) marks delete.
usage: Artifact types each get a hue: blue for documents, orange #90370f for slides, purple #5437b8 for designs, as an icon in menus and a pale tile behind it (#cce3fd, #f7d9ca, #e4deff).

type.summary: anthropic-sans, a variable face, for all UI text, in steps finer than the usual weights: 400 for body text, 435 for buttons, menu rows and links, 520 for dialog titles (15px), 540 for badges (11px). Controls are 14px on a 20px line, secondary rows 13px on 17px, tooltips 13px on 18px, the composer 15px on 21px. Icons are glyphs of the Anthropicons icon font, mostly 20px and 16px.

shape.summary: 8px corners (--cds-radius) on buttons, menu rows, links and fields; 10px on large buttons; 14px on menus and the composer; 11px on connector cards; 12px on the settings dialog and 20px on the search palette. Tooltips round to 6px and checkboxes to 4px. Badges, switches, the day toggles and the memory field are pills.

spacing.summary: A 4px base (--spacing .25rem). Most controls are 28px: icon buttons are 28px square, text buttons pad 9px, menu rows 10px. Sidebar rows and the settings buttons are 32px; small buttons 24px with 8px sides; the large button 40px with 16px sides at 15px. Two-line menu rows (the model picker) are 46px.

elevation.summary: Edges are 1px rings drawn as shadows: black at 8% (white at 4% in dark). Menus add 0 8px 24px at 12% and 0 2px 6px at 8%; the composer 0 4px 20px at 3.5% over a 12% ring; dialogs and tooltips 0 1px 2px at 6% and 0 2px 8px at 8%. The search palette floats higher, on 0 25px 50px -12px at 25% with a 0.5px edge. Focus is a 1px #257de0 ring with a 6px glow at 12%, inside a 1px ring in the page color.

button.summary: Most buttons are ghost: no fill until hover (#f2f2f2) and pressed (#e5e5e5), 8px corners, 14px at 435. The census reads the fill of the button itself, and CDS paints filled buttons on an inner layer, so secondary buttons (black at 5% on that layer) fall in the ghost column; primary (the ink) and clay are read in full. Disabled keeps the fill and greys the text to #969696.

provenance.notes: Written block by block from the census (spec.json, census 4fcf712) and its frozen copies: 32 signed-in pages of claude.ai in light and dark (chats, projects, artifacts, Customize, every Settings tab, the upgrade page), read in Mehdi's research Chrome on a new account, so lists are mostly empty states and only the first onboarding screen was seen. Signed-in text is redacted in the copies, so parts were named from their layout, icons and values. Names marked ai are ours; the size names without a from are CDS's data-size values.
